The black plateskirt requires 10 [[Defence]] to wear. One can be bought from [[Ranael's Super Skirt Store]] in [[Al Kharid]]. As with all [[Black equipment|black]] and [[white equipment]], the black plateskirt cannot be made from raw materials using the [[Smithing]] skill. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -21 |arange = -11 |dstab = +21 |dslash = +20 |dcrush = +19 |dmagic = -4 |drange = +20 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = legs |image = [[File:Black plateskirt equipped male.png|170px]] |altimage = [[File:Black plateskirt equipped female.png|170px]] }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Black plateskirt}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Black plateskirt}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Black plateskirt}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The plateskirt's ranged attack bonus has been decreased from -7 to -11. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Black plateskirt detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black plateskirt detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Black plateskirt (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Black plateskirt.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
